name: google-business-profile-reviews-and-replies
description: Reads the reviews on a Google Business Profile listing, from live Google Business Profile data in your Coupler.io workspace — rating and review volume over time, the share of one- to three-star reviews, how many reviews got a reply and how fast, which low ratings are still unanswered, and what the written reviews keep complaining about or praising, per location. Use for "how are our Google reviews", "are our ratings going down", "which reviews haven't we replied to", "how fast do we reply to reviews", "what are customers complaining about on Google", "compare ratings across our locations", "Google review report" — even when the user never says "reviews". This is the reputation read. For views, calls and direction requests use google-business-profile-performance-report; for the client write-up use google-business-profile-client-report. Google Business Profile only.
